fact: Niger's Interior Ministry launched mass biometric enrolment on 15 September 2026 for the AES e-passport range, which includes a travel document for refugees, with enrolment devices to be installed in every region.
Diffa's regional civil-status directorate, with UNICEF support, deployed mobile teams to sites hosting displaced people to register births between July 2023 and July 2026.

UNHCR Niger says 2,237 refugees and IDPs were registered or verified in 2025 and 1,542 refugee certificates and ID cards were distributed, including 641 refugee cards from the Agadez biometric verification of 1,784 people in November-December 2025.

UNHCR says that since 2019 Niger has delivered over 24,600 birth certificates (9,700 refugee and 14,900 internally displaced children), 4,616 nationality certificates and 2,700 national identity cards for displaced populations.
Niger's humanitarian action minister launched biometric registration of internally displaced people in Diffa region on 20 January 2024, expected to cover about 160,000 people.
